question: Where is the Vivekanand Rock Memorial situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanyakumari**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vivekanand Rock Memorial** is located in **Kanyakumari**, the **southernmost tip of mainland India**.
 
• The memorial was built in **1970 **in honor of **Swami Vivekananda** who is said to have attained enlightenment on the rock.
 
• It consists of two main structures - the **Vivekananda Mandapam** and the **Shripada Mandapam**.
 
• The memorial is a popular tourist destination and a place of pilgrimage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swami Vivekananda** was a key figure in the introduction of Indian philosophies of **Vedanta and Yoga** to the Western world.
 
• He is also credited with raising interfaith awareness, bringing Hinduism to the status of a major world religion during the late 19th century.
 
• The rock memorial is situated about** 500 meters east of the mainland of Vavathurai**.
 
• Visitors can reach the memorial by taking a ferry service from the mainland.
